absences: No dated fuel-supply or financing event after 2026-10-14 found in any angle. Searches returned only events dated on or before 2026-10-05 (for example EDF's $4.2B Vistra conditional commitment dated 2026-10-05, a large-reactor uprate loan and therefore outside this tab's microreactor scope, and already dated before the window).

Alaska: the shipped claim that the state regulator puts rural Alaska at $410-1,950/MWh could not be verified. The RCA/AEA PCE notice fetched (dated 2026-05-01, aws.state.ak.us id=223712) gives the PCE base of 20.38 cents/kWh and a proposed 22.11 cents/kWh for FY2027 for Anchorage, Fairbanks and Juneau residential averages, and no $410-1,950/MWh band. No contradiction found, so no check written.

Incentives: the shipped claim that nuclear under 45Y/48E is available for construction beginning before 2034 is supported by a Morgan Lewis article dated 2025-07-24 (fetched). That is a secondary source and older than the ~60-day window for a confirmed verdict; no check written. Treasury/IRS nuclear-specific guidance in 2026 was not found.

HALEU: no 2026 cumulative delivery total was found. Sources conflict on delivered kilograms (900 kg by June 2025 vs. more than 920 kg; a 1,900 kg lifetime figure in a press release). DOE's 21 MT by June 2026 target status was not confirmed. No check written.
Centrus $900M DOE task order (January 2026) and July 2026 contract finalization are already on the shipped news tab; no new event found.
No Oct 2026 microreactor financing round found. Latest found: Valar $1B Series B (2026-08-06), Antares Series C (date not confirmed), Radiant >$300M (date not shown).
No Oct 2026 TRISO supply deal found. Latest: Standard Nuclear with Antares (2026-08-27) and Radiant (2026-08-20), both already shipped.
No Oct 2026 Orano, Urenco or GLE enrichment award found. The shipped January 2026 $2.7B task orders are the latest.
Searches were run with WebSearch only; the DOE and company newsrooms were not fetched directly for October 2026 items, so an unindexed October event is possible.
